text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px solid white inner ring for interactive elements. This ensures high contrast against any background while keeping the ring visible on dark or light themes. The trade-off is slightly larger visual footprint, but it guarantees keyboard users can always see where they are.

name: Reader
text: The 4px outer ring with 2px white inner ring still risks blurring on low-contrast backgrounds when users zoom or switch themes. A 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring keeps the footprint smaller while maintaining visibility. Test it at 200% zoom on a light gray background—if the ring remains crisp, it’s the better choice.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #005fcc ring with 1px white inner ring. It’s tighter, so it won’t blur or shrink as much on low-contrast backgrounds or at 200% zoom, keeping the focus indicator crisp for everyone. The trade-off is a slightly less bold ring, but visibility wins over size—keyboard users must see it, no exceptions.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks disappearing entirely on backgrounds where #005fcc blends too closely with the theme—especially at 200% zoom or on patterned surfaces. A 4px ring with a 1px white inner ring keeps the footprint bold enough to survive low-contrast attacks while still shrinking gracefully. Test it on a #f0f0f0 background at 200% zoom; if the ring stays unbroken, it’s the safer call.
